settings.heading: Psychological Evaluations
settings.description: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. Diagnostic clarity that informs treatment planning, school supports, and clinical decision-making.

settings.heading: Group Therapy
settings.description: Community-grounded groups focused on grief, parenting, and somatic resourcing. Structured and time-limited, with open enrollment periods.

settings.heading: Consultation
settings.description: Case consultation for clinicians and referral conversations for families. Available by arrangement to licensed professionals and referring providers.

settings.heading: A practice built on relationship.
settings.body: Center for Balanced Living is a trauma-based clinical services practice in Middletown, Delaware. We work with adults, adolescents, and children navigating trauma, anxiety, grief, developmental challenges, and identity questions. Our approach is evidence-based, relationally grounded, and attentive to the whole person: mind, body, and spirit.

settings.name: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.bio_short: A trauma-based psychologist, educator, and writer. Dr. Serravalle founded the Center for Balanced Living to offer psychologically rigorous, relationally grounded care.

settings.quote: Working with this practice changed how I understand myself. The care here is unlike anything I'd experienced before, careful, steady, and real.
